sessionBrowser.reason: launch-serve.ts does not yet wire sessionBrowser: true, which disables session_list/search/read tools, contextMilestones reminders, and model-initiated session_rollover on the web server; remove once serve enables sessionBrowser and web-client renders rollover boundaries.

mcp.reason: MCP server lifecycle and OAuth are intentionally terminal-only for now; web chats run without per-workspace MCP server processes.

mcpCatalog.reason: MCP catalog refresh is intentionally terminal-only alongside appWiring.mcp because no MCP manager runs in term2 serve.

hooks.reason: Public shell hooks are intentionally terminal-only (TUI and headless) to keep term2 serve's sandboxed execution boundary narrow.

take_over_review.reason: src/host/server*.ts does not yet expose an HTTP route to take over an in-progress approval review while the safety arbiter is running; remove once the route and web UI indicator are wired.

cancel.reason: POST /sessions/:id/abort hardcodes target: foreground and discardQueue: true without supporting returnSteers or queue-preserving cancel; remove once /abort exposes those options.

retry.reason: POST /sessions/:id/commands supports retry-turn and retry-tool when idle, but does not yet accept an executionId target for retrying a specific tool call; remove once executionId is validated and forwarded.

configure.reason: POST /sessions/:id/config intentionally omits per-session temperature overrides because agent.temperature is deliberately hidden in the web UI (NEVER_SHOWN_KEYS).

queue_edit.reason: POST /sessions/:id/queue validates text-only edits for queued messages and does not yet allow editing attachments; remove once attachment edits are validated and forwarded.

command_status.reason: src/host/server*.ts intentionally omits a standalone command_status endpoint because web clients rely on idempotent command retries and snapshot.commands.

reset.reason: Web intentionally uses draft-first New chat in the sidebar instead of resetting an existing logical session in place via /clear.

rollover.reason: server-commands.ts rejects rollover with 422 command_not_allowed because sessionBrowser and rollover UI boundaries are not yet wired for web; remove alongside appWiring.sessionBrowser.

preview.reason: Pre-send input-surge and large-uncached-context confirmation is intentionally terminal-only for now; web submits directly without a preview round-trip.

approval_review.reason: web-client folds reviewingApprovals into the snapshot but does not yet render a live indicator or takeover action while the AI safety reviewer is evaluating an approval; remove once rendered.

budget_opened.reason: web-client renders run_budget interactions only when the gateway attaches an interaction DTO; standalone pendingBudgets without a DTO return null in TranscriptTail.tsx; remove once BudgetPanel parity is added.

compaction_completed.reason: web-client folds compaction completion into snapshot.notices (visible in Diagnostics), but does not yet render a persistent compaction notice in the main transcript; remove once transcript notices render.

compaction_failed.reason: web-client shows compaction failure transiently during an active turn, but does not yet persist the failure notice in the main transcript after the turn settles; remove once transcript notices render.

session_rotated.reason: web-client folds session_rotated via reduceWireEvent, which clears foreground turns silently without a rollover boundary divider or banner; remove once rollover UI is implemented.

notice.reason: web-client exposes snapshot.notices only inside the opt-in Diagnostics panel rather than rendering general runtime notices in the main chat view; remove once a notice surface is added.

automatic_memory_notice.reason: web-client folds automatic_memory_notice into snapshot.notices without surfacing it in the main chat transcript outside Diagnostics; remove once general notices render in chat.

goal_proposed.reason: web-client renders active goals read-only via GoalBanner and does not yet surface or let users accept/dismiss proposed goals; remove once interactive goal management is added to serve and web-client.

agent.disabledProviders.reason: Web manages provider enable/disable state through the dedicated Providers section and provider toggle endpoints rather than through WEB_SETTINGS safe defaults.

agent.runBudget.escalation.reason: Run-budget escalation mode is not yet exposed in WEB_SETTINGS or web-client Settings; remove once the Limits section includes run-budget controls.

agent.runBudget.maxActiveTimeMs.reason: Run-budget active time limit is not yet exposed in WEB_SETTINGS or web-client Settings; remove once the Limits section includes run-budget controls.

agent.runBudget.maxUnpricedTokens.reason: Run-budget unpriced token cap is not yet exposed in WEB_SETTINGS or web-client Settings; remove once the Limits section includes run-budget controls.

agent.runBudget.maxUsdMicros.reason: Run-budget USD spend cap is not yet exposed in WEB_SETTINGS or web-client Settings; remove once the Limits section includes run-budget controls.

app.notifications.reason: Web uses browser-local Web Notification preferences in web-client instead of writing the TUI's terminal notification setting on the server.

app.notificationsOnApproval.reason: Web uses a single browser-local notification toggle rather than per-event terminal notification flags; revisit if granular browser notification toggles are added.

app.notificationsOnComplete.reason: Web uses a single browser-local notification toggle rather than per-event terminal notification flags; revisit if granular browser notification toggles are added.

shell.backgroundTimeout.reason: Background shell timeout is not yet exposed in WEB_SETTINGS or web-client Settings Limits; remove once added to web-settings-policy.ts and settings-catalog.ts.

ui.displayMode.reason: Web stores its own browser-local tool display mode (concise/standard) rather than mutating the terminal UI's ui.displayMode setting.

ui.skin.reason: Terminal layout skins (classic, cards, ledger, rail, zen) apply only to the Ink TUI and do not exist in the web UI.

ui.theme.reason: Web manages Light/Dark/System appearance locally via ThemeContext rather than writing the terminal UI's ui.theme setting.
